business_problem: Software development can be a time-consuming and labor-intensive process. Coders at Visma, a software company headquartered in Oslo, have to conquer a wide array of challenges as they develop and test software for a diverse collection of customer organizations. The company recently adopted GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Visual Studio. Soon thereafter, employees began developing new code as much as 50 percent faster, which has contributed to increased customer retention, faster time to market, and increased revenue.
